messages.subject: Re: [knitr] working directory after /SweaveInput
parts:
I just tested opts_knit$set(root.dir = '/tmp/') and I see the working
directory is /tmp/ everywhere. Are you sure you did not mix up
opts_knit and opts_chunk?

If you do not set root.dir, the working directory is the directory of
the input file, which has been documented in ?knit and mentioned in
the news: https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/NEWS.md#new-features

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] working directory after /SweaveInput
parts:
opt_knit is independent of document formats so it should work for Rmd
we asll, but note \SweaveInput{} does not work for Rmd. You are
recommended to use the child option, e.g. ```{r child='foo.Rmd'}
(http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/child/)
